sources.name: Gunpula catalog — data/kits.json history + data/update-feed.json
sources.method: Diff of consecutive git versions of data/kits.json (same rule as scripts/build_update_feed.mjs, no item cap), merged with data/update-feed.json. Only new items and price / release / limited / source changes are kept. Restock items (reason restock) come from data/atlas/restocks.json.
sources.licence: Product facts (names, prices, release dates) collected by Gunpula from the official shops named in each kit's source_refs (BANDAI SPIRITS, Premium Bandai, Pokémon Center, Takara Tomy, Good Smile and others). Names, trademarks and pictures belong to their owners. No images are included; the published copy links each added / changed item's small cover thumbnail ("thumb", scripts/publish_site.mjs).
